template_components.name: phase_manifest
template_components.purpose: Declare phase id, focus, prior verified head, current live head, permitted scope, blocked scope, and artifact list before any publication action.
template_components.acceptance: A reviewer can tell what phase is being run, what head it starts from, and what live actions are forbidden without reading chat history.

template_components.name: live_write_gate
template_components.purpose: Separate inspect-only, dry-run, tempdir rehearsal, curated write, connector mutation, and destructive cleanup gates.
template_components.acceptance: No live write, cloud mirror, broad cleanup, or deletion can be mistaken for an automatically approved operation.

template_components.name: surface_inventory
template_components.purpose: Catalog command, skill, script, connector, plugin, repo, Drive, and document surfaces with evidence status and safe operating boundary.
template_components.acceptance: The inventory distinguishes locally verified capability from planned capability and from unavailable connector claims.

template_components.name: publication_checklist
template_components.purpose: Standardize the current-phase commit path without broad staging or hidden raw capture.
template_components.acceptance: The published artifact can be audited from local preparation through remote equality.

template_components.name: sibling_retry_prompt
template_components.purpose: Keep app and CLI advisory lanes useful without fabricating missing text or retrying known rate limits too early.
template_components.acceptance: A lane can fail, rate-limit, or return no exposed final text while the main phase still records the truth.

gm_ut_boundary.rule: THOS operational templates do not validate GMUT physics by association.
